# NOW THE DESCRIPTION
- With blood and rage of crimson red...
- What's mine is mine and mine and mine...
- ...Beware your fears made into light...
- ...No evil shall escape my sight...
- ...Look to the stars, for hope burns bright!
- ...Love conquers all with violet light!
- ...Taan lek lek nok--Formorrow Sur!
- ...By my black hand, the dead shall rise!

# Do you like green lantern?
maybe the other lanterns?

Then you found the right modpack!!

Scower the world and find crashed ships with rare loot, maybe a corpse or two. who knows maybe you will find a lantern ring and a spark of light. find 8 and craft a lantern to fuel your ring then you can become

# A LANTERN CORP MEMBER!!
